tagline: I build fast, conversion-focused Shopify stores with hand-written Liquid, CSS and JavaScript. No page builders, no bloat.
about: I'm a Shopify Developer and Designer based in Bangladesh, focused on custom Liquid sections, theme engineering and store automation. Everything I ship is hand-coded, so stores stay fast and easy to maintain.

I work with international brands and agencies on custom storefronts, multilingual and multi-market setups, Shopify Flow and Mechanic automations, and app integrations like Recharge, Appstle, Searchanise and Bambuser.

points: Build and customize Shopify themes for agency clients with custom Liquid sections and blocks
Ship theme features, bug fixes and speed improvements across multiple live client stores
Set up app integrations and store automations with Shopify Flow
Delivered 100+ Shopify stores and customizations for international clients
Custom sections on Dawn, Prestige, Focal and Horizon themes
